articles.title: American Football and Turnstile’s Brendan Yates Team Up for “No Feeling”: Stream
articles.summary: American emo band American Football has released a new track titled "No Feeling," featuring Brendan Yates from Turnstile. This song is the latest preview from their upcoming self-titled fourth album, indicating a significant collaboration within the midwest emo scene and generating anticipation for the full album's release, showcasing the band's evolving sound.
